extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners (attorneys, agents), prosecution strategists, patent prosecutors
extracted.subtask_description: Analyzing historical prosecution behavior of USPTO examiners and art units to inform prosecution strategy (amendments, interviews, appeals, RCEs, restrictions, timing). Presents metrics and data-driven recommendations specific to examiners/art units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance Rate
rubrics_metrics.description: The percentage of all applications under a given Examiner or art unit which are eventually allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to estimate how likely an application is to reach allowance under that Examiner/art unit; presented on the Dashboard tab as a core measure of favorable outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance Rate Comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: A bar chart showing the allowance rate of a given Examiner/art unit relative to other organizational units within the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows comparison of an Examiner/art unit's allowance performance against peers or USPTO averages to contextualize how permissive or strict the Examiner/art unit is.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prosecution Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: A timeline showing how the population of pending applications under a given Examiner or art unit evolves over time (e.g., by being allowed or abandoned).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps visualize trends in dispositions (allowances vs abandonments) over time for that Examiner/art unit; useful for seeing shifts in behavior or workload effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prosecution Speed
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimates the amount of time between filing an application and reaching final disposition under a particular Examiner or art unit. Equivalent to the half life of a pending application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an expectation for time-to-resolution, informing client timelines and prosecution planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office Actions per Application (Office Actions)
rubrics_metrics.description: The total number of Office Actions issued by an Examiner or art unit divided by the total number of applications processed by that Examiner/art unit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can be thought of as the likely number of Office Actions issued for an application before a final disposition; informs how many rounds of prosecution to expect and potential costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction Requirement Rate (Restrictions)
rubrics_metrics.description: The total number of restriction requirements issued by an Examiner or art unit divided by the total number of applications processed by that Examiner/art unit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalent to the probability of receiving a restriction requirement; helps with claim drafting and divisional strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview Benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: The allowance rate for applications in which at least one Examiner interview is conducted minus the allowance rate for applications in which no Examiner interview is conducted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures whether conducting interviews correlates with higher allowance probability for that Examiner/art unit; guides decisions about whether to invest in interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent Applications Detail (100 most recent applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed table of the 100 most recent applications examined, including filing date, disposition, office actions, restrictions, interview status, appeal status, and time to disposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sortable columns allow pattern analysis across applications; direct links to USPTO Patent Center for each application enable deep dives into file histories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time to Disposition (from Recent Apps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time to disposition for recent applications (how long it took individual applications to be allowed/abandoned).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to analyze variability and expected timeframes for prosecution under the Examiner/art unit; supports client expectation setting and scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: PTAB Decision Reversal Rate (Appeals Analysis / PTAB Decision Statistics)
rubrics_metrics.description: The percentage of PTAB decisions in which the Examiner or art unit is reversed, with comparative percentile rankings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates historical success of appeals against that Examiner/art unit at the PTAB; helps evaluate likely effectiveness of appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal Filing Benefit
rubrics_metrics.description: The percentage of cases where filing an appeal leads to allowance (with or without the appeal proceeding to a PTAB decision), indicating if simply filing an appeal helps reach allowance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures whether filing an appeal historically correlates with achieving allowance; useful for deciding whether to file an appeal versus other routes (RCE, after-final, pre-appeal conference).

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Recommendations (Appeals and Prosecution Strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data-driven guidance on when appeals are likely to be effective based on historical patterns for the Examiner or art unit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides actionable suggestions (e.g., when to appeal, when to seek pre-appeal conferences) grounded in the Examiner's past behavior; intended to inform strategy rather than prescribe a single approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary Report (Comprehensive Written Analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive written analysis of prosecution patterns and strategic recommendations, including detailed guidance on interview effectiveness, RCE strategy, after-final amendments, pre-appeal conferences, and petition practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes percentile-based comparisons showing how the examiner or art unit compares to USPTO averages and cites relevant MPEP references for prosecution procedures; meant to be a consolidated playbook tailored to the Examiner/art unit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentile-Based Comparisons to USPTO Averages
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentile-based comparisons showing how the examiner or art unit compares to USPTO averages across metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps benchmark an Examiner/art unit against broader USPTO behavior to understand relative strictness, speed, and appeal outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Application Links to USPTO Patent Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct links to USPTO Patent Center for each application listed in recent application data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitates verification and deeper review of file histories; enables manual inspection of office actions and examiner behavior beyond aggregated metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philosophy: Avoiding Aggregate 'Grade' and Presenting Raw Metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid giving Examiners an overall 'grade' using a home-brewed formula; instead present comprehensive prosecution metrics and let practitioners make decisions based on the most relevant data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages users to weigh metrics differently depending on client situation and case specifics; the product intentionally minimizes assumptions so users can form context-dependent strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP References for Relevant Prosecution Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: References to the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) for procedures relevant to prosecution tactics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports recommended strategies with authoritative procedural citations; useful for practitioners who need the governing procedural rules when implementing recommendations (e.g., petition practice, after-final amendments).
